error.message: This is a front-end-only preview — the analytics API is not deployed.

details.why: The backend is a stateful Flask + TensorFlow process. Netlify serves static sites and cannot host it.
details.runLocally: git clone https://github.com/Jay14090/stock-analytics-forecasting-dashboard && cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && flask --app wsgi run
details.toConnectAnApi: Deploy the backend to Render, Railway or Fly.io, then point the /api/* redirect in frontend/netlify.toml at it.
